brief: Prioritise Stonebridge Lock 230/34kV for pre-event attention ahead of a younger unit in otherwise similar condition because it is a unit of advanced age with a history of high loading, giving it a reduced margin against mechanical failure ([MG-023]). Where this ageing unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure ([MG-023]). Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period ([MG-021]).
